explanation: The double-headed eagle was the emblem of Skanderbeg, the national hero who led Albanian resistance to the Ottoman Empire. Montenegro's flag eagle is gold.

claims.text: The flag of Albania shows a black double-headed eagle on a red background.
Montenegro's flag shows a gold double-headed eagle, Serbia's state flag shows a white double-headed eagle on a red, blue and white tricolour, and Russia's flag has no eagle.
The double-headed eagle was the emblem of Skanderbeg.
Skanderbeg, Albania's national hero, led resistance to the Ottoman Empire.
The eagle on Montenegro's flag is gold.
